name: Corciano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Corciano (red and white chequy) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Corciano, a comune in Umbria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 15 August 1929.

features.role: Corciano arms — red and white chequy, crowned, within branches
